step.text: Runs once per successful player step (main.lua, before the encounter roll). Per-step trait effects live here so they stay data-authored: MOVE_HEAL regenerates while walking, reusing HEAL's trait form exactly like POST_BATTLE_HEAL does on victory.

Ordinary traversal is free. Merely keeping manifested companions available must not tax every step or reward reserve micromanagement. Expedition MP pressure is charged when the party is actively channelled into battle; future Veil/avoidance traversal may add an exceptional player-chosen spend.
Keep the `warded` state in step with whatever death ward the creature is currently carrying, so the player can SEE it before deciding to descend further.

expedition_start.text: Runs when the party leaves a safe map for a dangerous one (engine/exploration.lua loadMap). One expedition = one trip out of town, not one floor.
